title: Add `dataframeHeaderTextColor` theme option for dataframe header text
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Add a `dataframeHeaderTextColor` theme option to control the foreground (text) color of `st.dataframe` / `st.data_editor` column headers. Today `dataframeHeaderBackgroundColor` exists, but the header text color can't be customized — it's always derived from the body `textColor` (as `fadedText60`), so a custom/tinted/dark header background often results in weak or unreadable header text.

### Why?

Users can already set a custom header background via `dataframeHeaderBackgroundColor`, but there's no matching control for the header text. With a dark or strongly tinted header background, the faded, body-derived header text has poor contrast and can be hard to read. A dedicated `dataframeHeaderTextColor` lets the header background and foreground be styled together for a readable, on-brand look.

### How?

Add a theme config option, e.g.:

```toml
[theme]
dataframeHeaderBackgroundColor = "#1f2937"
dataframeHeaderTextColor = "#ffffff"
```

Implementation notes:
- Wire it through the dataframe's custom theme so it overrides the header text color instead of the hardcoded default.
- In the frontend this currently maps to the glide-data-grid `textHeader` (and likely `textGroupHeader`), which today is set to `theme.colors.fadedText60`:

```117:119:frontend/lib/src/components/widgets/DataFrame/hooks/useCustomTheme.ts
      textHeader: theme.colors.fadedText60,
      textHeaderSelected: theme.colors.white,
      textGroupHeader: theme.colors.fadedText60,
```

- If unset, fall back to today's derived default (so nothing changes for existing apps).

### Additional Context

- Complements the existing `dataframeHeaderBackgroundColor` theme option.
- Related: #6958 (keep header style), #6340 (style tables)
